support_levels.0: Independent: no translation, answer bank, model, correction or extra replay before submit
support_levels.1: French clue, visual cue or slower replay
support_levels.3: Translation, worked example, answer reveal or copying

rules.support_policy: Any support applies to the response actually helped. A bilingual interface instruction alone is not answer support. Any target-bearing transcript on a listening check changes the response to supported reading/listening; never log it as independent listening.

independent_typed.known_limitation: iOS predictive text cannot be guaranteed off. Ask once in parent setup; record keyboard_support_unknown when not confirmed. Do not claim independent spelling in that case.

rules.completion: Required learning steps attempted, feedback offered, story checkpoint saved. Wrong answers trigger teaching, never a knockout or locked chapter.

mastery.settings: Pilot parameters, not scientific universal thresholds. Count evidence by exact skill and response demand; do not average receptive and productive evidence.

scheduler.first_review: first session starting at least 48 hours after teaching, after the specific skill reaches Ready to check
scheduler.failure: Needs review; teach now, then offer a different check at the next eligible session
scheduler.not_due: recap with no retention credit; do not consume fresh delayed items before Ready to check
scheduler.overdue: review first; never require daily attendance
scheduler.overflow: queue remaining checks next session; never silently discard
scheduler.exhaustion: Do not recycle a known answer and call it fresh transfer. Mark fresh_bank_exhausted and request a versioned content amendment.

rules.writing: Exact authored variants may confirm only the named narrow sentence-pattern skill. Other reasonable answers await review; absence from a finite key is not proof of error. Novel writing receives no automatic broad writing band.
rules.speaking: Listen, record, compare, retry; transcript says The device heard. Recording, replay and transcript agreement are not pronunciation or productive mastery. A named capable listener may record an observation; no machine band.
rules.privacy: Raw audio local only, explicit record action; keep only if parent chooses retention. No external speech service, secrets or upload.
rules.scoring_feedback: Learning correctness feedback allowed after submission, never before. Teach the likely error, offer a guided retry, schedule a different independent check later. Historical cards have completion/understanding records only.
rules.prerequisites: Recommend help based on evidence; never block the shared story when a prerequisite is weak. Adapt support and response demand, not historical facts.

device_voice.evidence: Reported family-iPad check in release-b-brief.md, 2026-09-29; not observed by content author
device_voice.fallback: Disclose actual voice; preserve locale when available; reading fallback is not listening evidence

session_frequency.policy: Do not require consecutive-day sessions; due queue advances at the next actual eligible session.

rules.typed_meaning: Compare only against authored accepted sentences and their explicit accent-only equivalents. Record spelling separately. Never grant W_ENCODING credit from an accent-tolerant sentence match.
rules.no_home_reviewer: Open writing/speaking remains unjudged. A bounded task can confirm its authored key, not all valid French. Unlisted wording is saved and gets a worked example plus a checkable practice route; it never blocks story progress.
rules.baseline_routing: Shared story. More-supported grammar and production initially for both profiles. Listening: Foundation support for baseline profile B, Developing support for profile A; reading Foundation for both. These are provisional supports, not new learning mastery evidence.
rules.credit_scope: Chapter sentence targets measure construction from given French lexical cues. C2 does not establish independent causal justification, and C4 does not establish independent explanation of reasons. Longer reasons remain guided enrichment.

rubrics.scorer_requirement: Named French-capable human reviews the original text. Self-check and AI drafts do not establish productive mastery.
